kultivator.dunia.pack.gua: Kultivator: caves, inheritance tombs, lairs and natural sites
kultivator.sibuk.tempat.warisan: taking a trial in an Inheritance Tomb
kultivator.sibuk.tempat.cermin: facing a heart demon in the Heart Mirror Cave
kultivator.gua.veto: Disciples wait at the entrance while their master takes a closed trial.
kultivator.gua.gua_pertapa.inspired: Inspired by hermits who withdraw to mountain caves and test would-be disciples with herbs, stillness and koans, a common wuxia and xianxia trope; the trials and numbers are the game's own.
kultivator.gua.makam_warisan.inspired: Inspired by ancestral inheritance tombs that keep a remnant soul and trials for an heir, a staple of xianxia novels (Renegade Immortal and A Record of a Mortal's Journey among them); the trial rooms and rewards are the game's own.
kultivator.gua.sarang_binatang.inspired: Inspired by demonic beast dens led by a pack king in cultivation stories; the design is the game's own.
kultivator.gua.sarang_iblis.inspired: Inspired by the hideouts of demonic-path cultivators who kidnap mortals to refine them, a common xianxia trope; the design is the game's own.
kultivator.gua.urat_roh.inspired: Inspired by spirit veins deep in the earth where spirit stones and crystals grow, a common xianxia setting; the guardians and numbers are the game's own.
kultivator.gua.cermin_hati.inspired: Inspired by the Heart Mirror and the inner-demon trials of I Shall Seal the Heavens; the design is the game's own.
kultivator.gua.puncak_petir.inspired: Inspired by lightning tribulations weathered on mountain peaks and watched by wanderers in xianxia novels; the terrace, the Record Stone and the numbers are the game's own.
kultivator.gua.panggung_bintang.inspired: Inspired by the ancient Chinese armillary sphere (hunyi) and the court's sky watchers; the link to the Star Calamity is the game's own.
kultivator.gua.mata_air_roh.inspired: Inspired by spirit springs in blossom groves that restore qi in cultivation stories; the design is the game's own.
kultivator.gua.masuk.bahaya: The air of this place presses on your chest. This %s asks for at least %s; enter with great care.
kultivator.gua.pertapa.dupa: The incense burns: %s of %s minutes. Do not move.
kultivator.gua.pertapa.terputus: Your meditation broke. The incense is lit again from the start.
kultivator.gua.pertapa.dupa_habis: The incense is spent and you did not stir. Good. Your heart is stiller than this spring.
kultivator.gua.pertapa.pamit: Three trials, three answers. Tomorrow morning I go wandering; I leave this cave to whoever is willing to sit in it.
kultivator.gua.makam.segel_tolak: The tomb's seal refuses your touch. It knows only %s and above.
kultivator.gua.makam.segel_buka: The seal's glyphs light one by one, then the stone slides aside. Cold air smelling of sandalwood flows out.
kultivator.gua.makam.giok_bergetar: The Giok Warisan in your hand trembles in answer to the illusion. In this tomb, that jade's inheritance roll rises by ten points.
kultivator.gua.makam.boneka_diam: The guardian puppets stay seated. The tomb's remnant soul has not yet allowed you to be tested.
kultivator.gua.makam.boneka_bangkit: Wood creaks. The guardian puppets rise from their plinths and draw their wooden swords.
kultivator.gua.makam.lempeng_diam: The plate does not move under your hand.
kultivator.gua.makam.lempeng_tetap: This plate is carved fast: %s. The others must follow it.
kultivator.gua.makam.lempeng_petunjuk: The %s plate glows faintly. Set the five elements round the ring by the cycle in which each gives birth to the next: wood bears fire, fire earth, earth metal, metal water, water wood.
kultivator.gua.makam.ujian_lulus.chat: Your strength and understanding are proven. Return to the ancestor's remnant soul.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.1.0: Take it. Do not keep it in a chest; an inheritance left unused rots faster than my bones.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.2.0: For a hundred years I waited for worthy hands. Do not make my waiting a joke.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.3.0: Heaven once struck me down. Let this inheritance help you stand higher than where I fell.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_serigala.0: A howl echoes from the den. Yellow eyes light up among the bones.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_laba.0: Something moves behind the straw. Hairy legs hiss out of the dark.
kultivator.gua.sarang.anak: A stray cub peeks out from behind the straw, trembling. It could be tamed.
kultivator.gua.iblis.pintu_tolak: The cliff stone feels like any other under your hand. Perhaps your realm is not yet enough to feel its seam.
kultivator.gua.iblis.pintu_buka: The false stones grind aside. The stench of blood wells up from within.
kultivator.gua.iblis.band: The lair's guards scent your arrival!
kultivator.gua.iblis.sel_dijaga: The lock is too close to the guards. Defeat them first.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tawanan_terima_kasi: You... you came for us? Thank you, thank you!
kultivator.gua.iblis.tetua_ancam.0: Another pill ingredient walks in by itself. Your blood will perfect my brew.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tetua_kalah.chat: The Demon Elder falls. The blood pool stills; this lair will be quiet for some days.
kultivator.gua.urat.bangun.0: The crystals of the cave floor crack and chime. Two Crystal Guardians rise from the earth's vein.
kultivator.gua.cermin.tawar.0: The pool's surface mirrors a face that is not yours.
kultivator.gua.cermin.tombol.hover: A heart demon trial of your own choosing, once a day. Before this mirror a defeat weighs only half.
kultivator.gua.cermin.jauh: Sit in meditation at the mirror pool first.
kultivator.gua.cermin.ranah: The mirror stays blurred to you. This trial asks for %s.
kultivator.gua.cermin.sudah: The mirror has shown you your demon today. Return tomorrow.
kultivator.gua.cermin.gagal: Your reflection will not step out now (you are busy, not on firm ground, or heart demons are switched off).
kultivator.gua.cermin.usai: The ripples on the pool settle. Your reflection is a reflection again.
kultivator.gua.petir.penonton: %s wanderer(s) gather at the balustrade to watch your tribulation.
kultivator.gua.petir.terukir: The last bolt strikes the Record Stone: your name is carved there.
kultivator.gua.bintang.gulir.chat: The armillary hums to greet the Star Calamity %s you passed on this stage.
kultivator.gua.mata_air.minum: The spring water is cold and sweet. Qi flows back: +%s.
kultivator.gua.mata_air.sudah: You already drank from this spring today.
kultivator.gua.giok.arah: The Giok Warisan pulses: the nearest Inheritance Tomb lies %s blocks to the %s.
kultivator.gua.giok.tiada: The Giok Warisan is still: you know no Inheritance Tomb yet.
kultivator.gua.uji.tiada_makam: No live Inheritance Tomb room within 96 blocks.
kultivator.gua.uji.tiada_aula: No live tomb hall within 128 blocks.
kultivator.gua.uji.tiada_pertapa: No live Hermit's Cave within 64 blocks.
kultivator.gua.uji.tiada_penjaga: No live Spirit Vein Cave or Strength room within 64 blocks.
kultivator.gua.uji.warisan: Tomb of the %s Dao, tier %s · quest %s · stage %s · bits %s · inheritance factor %s
kultivator.gua.uji.cermin: Heart Mirror trial started (test: no daily limit, no realm gate).
kultivator.gua.uji.status: Caves: %s live run(s) · nearest %s · on %s · in a trial %s
advancement.kultivator.tempat.murid_pert: Pass the three trials of a cave hermit.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.pewaris_ma: Receive a remnant soul's inheritance in an Inheritance Tomb.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.sarang_ber: Defeat the leader of a Beast Den.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.pembebas.d: Free five captives from demonic cultivators' lairs.
kultivator.gua.petir.naik_mulai: The sky over the terrace thickens into a sea of light. The wanderers at the balustrade hold their breath: an immortal ascension begins on the Lightning Peak.
kultivator.gua.petir.naik_terukir: A shaft of golden light falls on the Record Stone. Your name is carved at the very top, on the line of those who ascended.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_serigala.1: The smell of old blood stings. From the dark tunnel, answering growls draw closer.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_serigala.2: The pack king lifts its head from the pile of bones. One howl, and the whole den wakes.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_laba.1: Silk threads tremble along every wall. You have just stepped on its web.
kultivator.gua.sarang.bangun_laba.2: The cocoons on the ceiling sway. Eight red eyes open at once.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tawanan_terima_kasi: Do not leave me here... Ah, the lock is open! Heavens, thank you!
My child is waiting in the village. I will tell them your name.
I have not eaten for three days. I thought I would end in that cauldron.
Hero... no, Senior! I will repay this debt of life one day.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tetua_ancam.1: You freed my ingredients? Then you will take their place yourself.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tetua_ancam.2: The upright path, the demonic path, all of it is only a stair. Tonight you become one of its steps.
kultivator.gua.iblis.tetua_ancam.3: It has been long since a cultivator came on their own. Your cauldron is already warm.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.1.1: I was no one while I lived. But what I found is real; use it humbly.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.1.2: If one day you have disciples, tell them your road began in this small tomb.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.2.1: My sect is gone, its masters have forgotten my name. Let its inheritance live in your hands.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.2.2: You passed not because you are strong, but because you did not give up. Remember that when your tribulation comes.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.3.1: I weathered nine bolts; the tenth burned my body away. Learn my mistake from this inheritance.
kultivator.gua.makam.pesan.3.2: For a thousand years my remnant soul held on only for this moment. Now I may rest.
kultivator.gua.urat.bangun.1: The spirit vein in the wall pulses blue. Stone and crystal fuse into two giant bodies.
kultivator.gua.urat.bangun.2: A chime rings from the depths. The guardians of this cave do not like greedy hands.
kultivator.gua.cermin.tawar.1: In the water, your reflection smiles before you do.
kultivator.gua.cermin.tawar.2: The pool whispers in your own voice: everything you regret is here.
kultivator.gua.cermin.tawar.3: Mangrove roots grip the bank. Your reflection waits with its hand held out.
kultivator.gua.lore.gua_pertapa.0: The scent of sandalwood incense lingers. Someone once sat still here for a very long time.
kultivator.gua.lore.gua_pertapa.1: Water drips from a stalactite into a small pool, rhythmic as the breath of someone meditating.
kultivator.gua.lore.gua_pertapa.2: Small scratches cover the wall: a hermit counting the days.
kultivator.gua.lore.gua_pertapa.3: Small glowing mushrooms grow among the rotting scroll racks.
kultivator.gua.lore.makam_warisan.0: Spirit lanterns light themselves as you pass. This tomb still remembers how to greet a guest.
kultivator.gua.lore.makam_warisan.1: The murals show a cultivator standing beneath nine lightning bolts.
kultivator.gua.lore.makam_warisan.2: The dust on the floor has lain untouched for centuries, except for your footprints.
kultivator.gua.lore.makam_warisan.3: From the depths comes a faint voice, as if someone were reciting a sutra.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_binatang.0: Bones lie scattered, some still fresh. Something eats well here.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_binatang.1: Claw marks a finger deep score the bark. Its dweller is no ordinary beast.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_binatang.2: The musty smell of wet fur and earth fills your nose.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_binatang.3: Silence. Too much silence. Even the birds do not dare sing near this den.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_iblis.0: The reek of blood and bitter herbs mixes into one. The cauldrons inside went out not long ago.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_iblis.1: Chains rattle in the distance. Someone down there is still alive.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_iblis.2: Red talismans hang upside down from the ceiling: the mark of the demonic path.
kultivator.gua.lore.sarang_iblis.3: A list of names on the wall is crossed out one by one. You would rather not know what it means.
kultivator.gua.lore.urat_roh.0: Purple crystals throw your light back a thousand times. The qi here is so thick you can taste it.
kultivator.gua.lore.urat_roh.1: An old miner's pick is still stuck in the wall. Its owner never came back.
kultivator.gua.lore.urat_roh.2: The stone underfoot is warm, beating slowly like the heart of the earth.
kultivator.gua.lore.urat_roh.3: A faint chime echoes from inside the geode, like a bell struck very far away.
kultivator.gua.lore.cermin_hati.0: A thin mist hangs over water that is far too still.
kultivator.gua.lore.cermin_hati.1: You hear steps behind you. When you turn, there is only your reflection in the pool.
kultivator.gua.lore.cermin_hati.2: Every drop that falls into the pool reflects a different face.
kultivator.gua.lore.cermin_hati.3: The air here presses on the heart, not the body. Old memories rise unbidden.
kultivator.gua.lore.puncak_petir.0: The copper pillars hum in the wind. The air smells like the end of a storm.
kultivator.gua.lore.puncak_petir.1: The terrace stone is scorched black in places: the marks of tribulations before yours.
kultivator.gua.lore.puncak_petir.2: From here the world lies wide below. The sky feels very close, and very watchful.
kultivator.gua.lore.puncak_petir.3: The names on the Record Stone glint faintly, as if lightning still lived in the carving.
kultivator.gua.lore.panggung_bintang.0: The quartz floor mirrors the sky. Standing here feels like floating among the stars.
kultivator.gua.lore.panggung_bintang.1: The armillary rings turn slowly with no one pushing them.
kultivator.gua.lore.panggung_bintang.2: A sky watcher once recorded every falling star from here. The book is long lost.
kultivator.gua.lore.panggung_bintang.3: The meadow wind carries the smell of grass and cold metal from the sky.
kultivator.gua.lore.mata_air_roh.0: Cherry petals float on water clear to the very bottom.
kultivator.gua.lore.mata_air_roh.1: The water's babble sounds like soft laughter. Your weariness eases just from hearing it.
kultivator.gua.lore.mata_air_roh.2: The stones on the spring bed glow pale green: earth qi rises with the water.
kultivator.gua.lore.mata_air_roh.3: A deer drinks on the far side, unafraid of you. This place is peaceful.
